topic.title: Troubleshooting
topic.shortdesc: Solutions for common issues you may encounter while using .

section.title: Application Does Not Start
section.p: Symptom: The application fails to launch or closes immediately after opening.

ol.li: Verify that your system meets the minimum requirements listed in the Installation topic.
Ensure no other instance of is already running.

section.title: Slow Performance
section.p: Symptom: The application responds slowly or freezes intermittently.

ol.li: Close unnecessary applications to free up system resources.
Increase the allocated memory in Edit Preferences Performance .
Check for available updates that may include performance improvements.

section.title: Contacting Support
section.p: If the above solutions do not resolve your issue, contact our support team at support@example.com with the following information:

ul.li: A detailed description of the issue and steps to reproduce it.
